text: おかげで　ポケモン　ずかんの　ページが　ふえたぜ！

structure.jp: ポケモン　ずかんの　ページが

patterns.name: 〜おかげで
patterns.explanation: おかげで says something good happened because of what came before. おかげで = 'thanks to that'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, cocky boy's way of pushing what he says. ふえたぜ = 'they've increased, man!'.
